svg.title: Wireframe 7: menu, club switcher, members and clubs on a phone
svg.desc: Six greyscale phone screens: the open menu, the admin's club switcher, the members list, the add coach form, the admin clubs list and the create club form.
svg.text: Wireframe 7 · Menu, members and admin · phone (375 px)
Routes: /members · /admin/clubs. Greyscale layout only: colours, fonts and icons are placeholders. Names and numbers are made up.
A
Menu (hamburger)
A coach sees Competitions, Lifters (Should) and Members.
Clubs is only shown to an admin. The signed-in user, role
and club are shown by Log out. The current page is marked.
B
Club switcher (admin)
The admin can edit every club, so the active club is always
visible: an orange pill in the top bar and an ADMIN band
under it on every page. Switching reloads in the new club
and is remembered. A coach sees just the club name.
C
Members (/members)
Coaches of the active club. Coaches and admins can add
coaches. Lifter accounts come later (C1), so no lifter
rows yet. Removing or editing coaches is not in the
first slice.
D
Add coach

g.text: Tell the new coach in person. They are added to SK Atlas.

svg.text: Name, email and a password the coach shares in person.
No self sign-up and no email is sent in the first slice.
The new coach belongs to the active club.
E
Clubs (/admin/clubs, admin only)
All clubs with counts. The active one is outlined and
marked ACTIVE, the others have Switch to. This is also
where an admin lands when no valid active club is saved.
F
Create club

g.text: Optional. Saves a step: they can log in right away.

svg.text: Only the club name is required. The optional first coach
is created in the same step so the club can start right
away (one extra server action, small).
